biggest_catch: The US program pays in PayPal Rewards points, not cash: each side gets 1,000 points redeemable for $10 cash back. The friend must spend $5+ within 30 days of signup, and the reward is capped at 10 friends.
catches: US reward is 1,000 PayPal Rewards points per side (redeemable for $10 cash back), earned when the friend joins and spends at least $5 within 30 days of signup.
Friend must join AND link their bank account or card; spend must occur within 30 days of signup.
Cap: up to 10 friends — maximum 10,000 points (about $100 cash back) per referrer.
Points are subject to the PayPal Rewards Program Agreement; the offer may be modified or terminated at any time.
Older third-party pages describing a flat '$10 cash' version are outdated — the current official US offer is points-based.

c1.evidence: PayPal, Inc. — real company; official 'Refer a Friend — PayPal US' terms page (sandbox.paypal.com/us/webapps/mpp/invite/terms, an official PayPal domain) crawled 11 days ago with full terms text.

c2.evidence: Official PayPal US referral terms: 'When they spend at least $5 (within 30 days of signup), you both can earn 1,000 points (redeemable for $10 cash back).' Up to $100 cash back for 10 friends.

c3.evidence: No fee; friend spends $5+ of their own money within 30 days.

c4.evidence: Timing governed by the PayPal Rewards Program Agreement; points are issued after the qualifying spend is confirmed.

eligibility: Referrer: existing PayPal user with access to the referral program. Friend: must not already have PayPal; signs up for a US personal account via the referral link, links bank account or card, and spends at least $5 within 30 days of signup.
notes: CORRECTION: the route's '$10 referral' is right in value but wrong in form — the current official US program pays 1,000 PayPal Rewards points per side (redeemable for $10 cash back), not $10 cash. Display must say '1,000 points ($10 cash back)'. The US terms page itself rendered as a JS shell on direct load, but the official terms text was obtained from the crawl of the official paypal.com terms URL. UK/IE variants pay flat €10/£10; US is points-based. steps: In the PayPal app or site, find your referral link under the invite/offers section.
Share it with a friend who does not already have PayPal.
Your friend signs up for a US personal PayPal account through your link and links their bank account or card.
Your friend spends at least $5 within 30 days of signup.
You and your friend each earn 1,000 PayPal Rewards points (redeemable for $10 cash back); up to 10 friends ($100 cash back total).
